problem_en: Evaluate the value of the product P = (1 + tan 1°)(1 + tan 2°)(1 + tan 3°)...(1 + tan 44°). If log2(P) = n, find n.
problem_hi: गुणनफल P = (1 + tan 1°)(1 + tan 2°)(1 + tan 3°)...(1 + tan 44°) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। यदि log2(P) = n है, तो n ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Product P = (1 + tan 1°)(1 + tan 2°)...(1 + tan 44°) ki value evaluate karo. Agar log2(P) = n hai, toh n find kijiye.
problem_hg_065: P = (1 + tan 1°)(1 + tan 2°)...(1 + tan 44°) ka product calculate karo. n ki value nikaalo agar log2(P) = n hai, par pehle karo pairs identify phir simplify karna.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Use the identity (1 + tan A)(1 + tan B) = 2 if A + B = 45°.
Step 3: There are exactly 22 such pairs, each equaling 2.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir -> The sequential instruction might cause an LLM to focus on individual term identification rather than applying the global product identity simultaneously.

problem_en: Find the value of S = sin²(π/7) + sin²(2π/7) + sin²(3π/7).
problem_hi: S = sin²(π/7) + sin²(2π/7) + sin²(3π/7) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: S = sin²(π/7) + sin²(2π/7) + sin²(3π/7) ki value find kijiye.
problem_hg_065: Expression S = sin²(π/7) + sin²(2π/7) + sin²(3π/7) solve karo. Answer nikaalte waqt dhyaan dena ki 10 aur log aaye calculation check karne.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Convert sin²x to (1 - cos 2x)/2. S = [3 - (cos 2π/7 + cos 4π/7 + cos 6π/7)] / 2.
Step 2: Let C = cos 2π/7 + cos 4π/7 + cos 6π/7. Use the formula for sum of cosines in AP.
Step 4: Using sin(3π/7) = sin(4π/7), C = [2 sin(2π/7) cos(2π/7) / sin(π/7)] * cos(4π/7) simplifies to -1/2.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye -> This is an additive trap. The LLM might try to add 10 to the numerator or the final result (7/4 + 10).
why_hard: Requires sum of cosine series formula and careful handling of roots of unity related identities.

problem_en: Calculate the value of tan 20° + 4 sin 20°.
problem_hi: tan 20° + 4 sin 20° का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: tan 20° + 4 sin 20° ki value calculate kijiye.
problem_hg_065: Value nikaalo tan 20° + 4 sin 20° ki. Isme na 3 se na 5 se divisible hone wala logic hai, bas square root simplify karo.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Write tan 20° as sin 20° / cos 20°. Expression becomes (sin 20° + 4 sin 20° cos 20°) / cos 20°.
Step 2: Use 2 sin A cos A = sin 2A. Expression becomes (sin 20° + 2 sin 40°) / cos 20°.
Step 3: Rewrite 2 sin 40° as sin 40° + sin 40°. Use sin C + sin D on sin 40° + sin 20°.
Step 4: (2 sin 30° cos 10° + sin 40°) / cos 20° = (cos 10° + sin 40°) / cos 20°.
Step 5: Convert cos 10° to sin 80°. sin 80° + sin 40° = 2 sin 60° cos 20°.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: na X se na Y se divisible -> Neither-nor trap. LLM might interpret this as a constraint on the solution space (integers) rather than just a distractor.
why_hard: Requires multiple non-obvious transformations of basic identities to reach a simplified surd.

problem_en: If x = sum from k=1 to 18 of cos²(5k°), find 4x.
problem_hi: यदि x = sum from k=1 to 18 of cos²(5k°), तो 4x ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Agar x = summation k=1 to 18 cos²(5k°) hai, toh 4x ki value nikaalo.
problem_hg_065: Summation k=1 se 18 tak cos²(5k°) calculate karo aur x nikaalo. Phir 4x ki value do, kyunki A se 20% zyada log sum check kar rahe hain.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: x = cos² 5° + cos² 10° + ... + cos² 85° + cos² 90°.
Step 2: Note cos² 90° = 0. The remaining 17 terms: (cos² 5° + cos² 85°) + (cos² 10° + cos² 80°) + ... + cos² 45°.
Step 3: Pair using cos² theta + sin² theta = 1 (since cos² 85° = sin² 5°). Pairs: 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + (1/sqrt(2))².
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada -> Percentage base trap. LLM might try to multiply the final answer by 1.2 or modify x by 20%.
why_hard: Requires careful counting of terms in a finite series and complementary angle pairing.

problem_en: Calculate the value of P = cos(π/15) cos(2π/15) cos(3π/15) cos(4π/15) cos(5π/15) cos(6π/15) cos(7π/15). Find 1/P.
problem_hi: P = cos(π/15) cos(2π/15) cos(3π/15) cos(4π/15) cos(5π/15) cos(6π/15) cos(7π/15) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। 1/P ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Value find karo P = cos(π/15) cos(2π/15)...cos(7π/15). 1/P ki value kya hogi?
problem_hg_065: Product P = cos(π/15) cos(2π/15)...cos(7π/15) evaluate karo. Final answer 1/P dena, jabki 3 lakh 75 hazaar terms nahi hain yahan.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Note that cos(3π/15) = cos(π/5) and cos(5π/15) = cos(π/3) = 1/2.
Step 3: Use the product formula cos(A)cos(2A)cos(4A)...cos(2^(n-1)A) = sin(2^n A) / (2^n sin A).
Step 5: Multiply by other terms: P = (1/2) * (-1/16) * (sqrt(5)+1)/4 * (1/2) = 1/2^7 (with sign adjustments).
Step 6: Correct identity value for cos(π/15)...cos(7π/15) is 1/2^7 = 1/128.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 75 hazaar -> Notation trap. LLM might mistake the numeric value of 1/P or P for a scaled version of 375000.
why_hard: Involves binary product formula with non-binary terms that must be evaluated separately.

problem_hg_065: Expression solve karo: tan 9° - tan 27° - tan 63° + tan 81°. Dono ko (first and last, middle two) pair karke simplify karna.
solution_steps_en: Step 2: Use tan theta + cot theta = 2/sin 2theta. (tan 9° + cot 9°) - (tan 27° + cot 27°).
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko -> Collective trap. The LLM might perform the operation on only one pair or misinterpret 'both' as needing to average them.
why_hard: Requires pairing complementary angles and using the specific values of sin 18° and cos 36°.

problem_hi: sin 10° sin 30° sin 50° sin 70° का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: sin 10° sin 30° sin 50° sin 70° evaluate kijiye.
problem_hg_065: sin 10° sin 30° sin 50° sin 70° ki value nikaalo. Baaki terms consider mat karna, bas ye chaar steps follow karo.
solution_steps_en: Step 3: Use the identity sin theta sin(60-theta) sin(60+theta) = 1/4 sin 3theta.
Step 4: Let theta = 10°. Then sin 10° sin 50° sin 70° = 1/4 sin 30° = 1/4 * 1/2 = 1/8.

problem_en: Find the value of sqrt(3) csc 20° - sec 20°.
problem_hi: sqrt(3) csc 20° - sec 20° का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: sqrt(3) csc 20° - sec 20° ki value find kijiye.
problem_hg_065: Expression sqrt(3) csc 20° - sec 20° solve karo. Calculation 6 mahine baad waali annual rate se mat kar dena.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Write in terms of sin and cos: sqrt(3)/sin 20° - 1/cos 20°.
Step 2: Common denominator: (sqrt(3) cos 20° - sin 20°) / (sin 20° cos 20°).
Step 3: Multiply and divide numerator by 2: 2 [ (sqrt(3)/2) cos 20° - (1/2) sin 20° ] / (sin 20° cos 20°).
Step 4: Use sin(A-B) identity: 2 [ sin 60° cos 20° - cos 60° sin 20° ] = 2 sin 40°.
Step 5: Use 2 sin 20° cos 20° = sin 40° for the denominator.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad -> Time-rate trap. While it's a trigonometry problem, the 'annual rate' phrasing might trick an LLM into looking for a compound interest or growth formula context.
why_hard: Requires the auxiliary angle transformation (a cos x + b sin x) to simplify the numerator.

problem_en: If cos x + cos y + cos z = 0 and sin x + sin y + sin z = 0, find the value of cos²((x-y)/2) + cos²((y-z)/2) + cos²((z-x)/2).
problem_hi: यदि cos x + cos y + cos z = 0 और sin x + sin y + sin z = 0 है, तो cos²((x-y)/2) + cos²((y-z)/2) + cos²((z-x)/2) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

problem_hg_065: Condition check karo: sum of cosines and sum of sines zero hain. Phir cos²((x-y)/2) + cos²((y-z)/2) + cos²((z-x)/2) ki value nikaalo, withdraw kar liya N mahine baad wala concept mat lagana.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: (cos x + cos y + cos z)² + (sin x + sin y + sin z)² = 0.
Step 2: Expand to get 3 + 2[cos(x-y) + cos(y-z) + cos(z-x)] = 0.
Step 7: Let's re-sum: 1.5 + (-1.5)/2 = 0.75? No, Step 6 arithmetic: (3 - 1.5)/2 = 0.75.
Step 8: The problem asks for 9/4? Re-checking sum. 3/2 + 3/4 = 9/4 if we use the sin squared side too. Let's fix gold: 3/4.

problem_en: Calculate the value of tan 6° tan 42° tan 66° tan 78°.
problem_hi: tan 6° tan 42° tan 66° tan 78° का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: tan 6° tan 42° tan 66° tan 78° ki value calculate kijiye.
problem_hg_065: Product evaluate karo: tan 6° tan 42° tan 66° tan 78°. Dono ko (inner pair and outer pair) group karke result nikaalo.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Rewrite using tan theta tan(60-theta) tan(60+theta) = tan 3theta.
Step 2: We have tan 6° and tan 66° (which is tan(60+6)). We need tan 54° to use the formula.
Step 3: We have tan 42° and tan 78° (which is tan(60+18)). We need tan 18° to use the formula.
Step 4: Expression = [tan 6° tan 54° tan 66°] * [tan 18° tan 42° tan 78°] / [tan 18° tan 54°].
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko -> Grouping trap. LLM might only evaluate one part of the required identity multiplication/division.
why_hard: Requires multiplying and dividing by terms to complete two different triple product identities.

problem_en: Find the sum S = cot 16° cot 44° + cot 44° cot 76° - cot 76° cot 16°.
problem_hi: S = cot 16° cot 44° + cot 44° cot 76° - cot 76° cot 16° का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: S = cot 16° cot 44° + cot 44° cot 76° - cot 76° cot 16° sum find kijiye.
problem_hg_065: Calculate karo: cot 16° cot 44° + cot 44° cot 76° - cot 76° cot 16°. Pehle karo tan mein convert phir check karna result.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let A = 16°, B = 44°, C = 76°. Note A + B = 60°.
Step 2: Use cot A cot B + cot B cot C + cot C cot A = 1 if A+B+C = 90. Not applicable here.
Step 3: Evaluate using cot(A+B) = (cot A cot B - 1) / (cot A + cot B).
Step 4: For A=16, B=44, cot 60 = (cot 16 cot 44 - 1) / (cot 16 + cot 44).
Step 6: Use the property for cot(A+B+C) or specific values. The standard JEE identity for these angles is 3.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir -> Procedural trap. Forcing a conversion to 'tan' first might make the algebra significantly more cumbersome and error-prone for an LLM.
why_hard: Involves cotangent sum identities with non-standard angle combinations.

problem_hi: sin 12° sin 48° sin 54° का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_065: Value nikaalo sin 12° sin 48° sin 54° ki. Pehle karo 2 se multiply phir divide identity ke liye.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Multiplying sin 12° sin 48° using 2 sin A sin B = cos(A-B) - cos(A+B).
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir -> The hint to multiply by 2 might lead the LLM to forget to divide back or apply the identity only to the first two terms and lose the third.
why_hard: Combines product-to-sum identities with specific trigonometric values of 36° and 54°.

problem_en: If A + B + C = π, find the value of sin 2A + sin 2B + sin 2C if A = π/6 and B = π/3.
problem_hi: यदि A + B + C = π है, तो sin 2A + sin 2B + sin 2C का मान ज्ञात कीजिए यदि A = π/6 और B = π/3 है।
problem_hg_030: Agar A + B + C = π hai, toh sin 2A + sin 2B + sin 2C find karo with A = π/6, B = π/3.
problem_hg_065: Sin 2A + sin 2B + sin 2C nikaalo. A is π/6 and B is π/3, baaki C nikaal kar sum karo, 10 aur log result check kar rahe hain.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Find C. C = π - (π/6 + π/3) = π - π/2 = π/2.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye -> Additive trap. LLM might add 10 to the sum of sines.
why_hard: Tests whether the LLM uses the conditional identity (4 sin A sin B sin C) or just plugs in values, while navigating distractors.
